identificationModule.briefTitle: Clinical Studies of TQB2930 Injection for the Treatment of Advanced Solid Tumors
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase Ib/II Clinical Trial of TQB2930 Injection in Combination With TQB2102 for Injection in Patients With HER2-Expressing Advanced Solid Tumors

leadSponsor.name: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Nanjing Shunxin Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a multicenter, open-label, multi-cohort phase Ib/II clinical study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of TQB2930 in combination with TQB2102 in patients with HER2-expressing advanced solid tumors.

armGroups.label: TQB2930 injection+TQB2102 for injection
armGroups.description:
TQB2930 injection: Intravenous infusion, administered once on Day 1 of each treatment cycle, 21 days as a treatment cycle.

TQB2102 for injection: Intravenous infusion, administered once on day 1 of each treatment cycle, 21 days as a treatment cycle.

interventions.name: TQB2930 injection+TQB2102 for injection
interventions.description:
TQB2930 Injection is a Human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor 2 (HER2) bispecific antibody.

TQB2102 for injection is a HER2 - targeted dual epitope Antibody-Drug Conjugate (ADC).
